description: After being reincarnated into a cultivation world, Han Jue discovers that he can treat cultivation like a video game, rerolling his cultivation potential and innate providence. Determined to live a long life without attracting unnecessary attention, he chooses to cultivate quietly and avoid danger. But after a thousand years, the mortal world begins facing a devastating purge by powerful immortals, forcing Han Jue to finally reveal a fraction of his hidden strength.
author: Ren Wo Xiao (Let Me Laugh) / Star Club
